data.description: Live the Lagoon Life at Elysian Mansions

data.answer: Elysian Mansions is part of the master-planned Tilal Al Ghaf development by Majid Al Futtaim. This off-plan residential community is nestled along the Central Lagoon Al Ghaf and offers a resort-like lifestyle with easy access to the city. The project includes three distinctive mansion styles: Park Lane, Hilltop, and Lagoonside, catering to various tastes and location preferences within the community.

Majid Al Futtaim Elysian Mansions offers a collection of bespoke waterfront mansions in Dubai. These villas come in 5 to 7-bedroom configurations and feature smart home technology, triple-height courtyards, private elevators, car porches, and options for rooftop Sky Suites and multipurpose basements.

Each mansion is customisable, allowing owners to tailor interior layouts, basement functions, and rooftop experiences to their preferences. Residences can be located next to the Central Lagoon Al Ghaf with private beach access or nestled amidst tranquil gardens. These high-end homes provide the ultimate blend of privacy, innovation, and lifestyle.

Buying a Property in Elysian Mansions

Elysian Mansions off-plan villas are available through a 60/40 payment plan by Majid Al Futtaim. Buyers pay 10% as a down payment, followed by 60% during construction and 40% over five years post-handover. The expected handover is Q4 2025, with August 2025 being the target date.
With limited supply and a prime waterfront location in Tilal Al Ghaf, these properties have seen strong interest from investors and end-users alike. The luxury market appeal, coupled with the reputation of Majid Al Futtaim, makes these villas a valuable long-term investment.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Elysian Mansions Dubai?

data.answer:
Life in Elysian Mansions Dubai offers the tranquillity of lagoon-side living with the perks of a high-end urban lifestyle. The community's design promotes wellness, sustainability, and social engagement. 

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Elysian Mansions

Each mansion in Elysian Mansions comes with dedicated covered parking spaces. Being an off-plan project, public transportation access is currently limited, but nearby communities like Dubai Sports City offer bus services including F37 and F38.

For metro users, Jumeirah Golf Estates Metro Station on the Red Line is the closest option, about 18 minutes away by car. Residents will also have direct access to Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311), ensuring smooth commutes across Dubai.

Supermarkets Around Elysian Mansions

Carrefour, located within the master Tilal Al Ghaf community, serves as the primary supermarket for residents. It is strategically positioned to ensure convenience for all sub-communities. Additional options such as Al Maya Supermarket and Spinneys are located in neighboring areas, offering a diverse range of grocery and household items.

Schools and Nurseries Near Elysian Mansions

Elysian Mansions residents will have convenient access to quality schools and nurseries. Royal Grammar School Guildford, Dubai is located within Tilal Al Ghaf and follows the British curriculum from Early Years to A-level. Other well-regarded schools nearby include South View School in Dubailand and Jebel Ali School in DAMAC Hills.

Families living in Elysian Mansions can also choose from nearby nurseries such as Jebel Ali Village Nursery, which follows the EYFS curriculum, and Kids Kingdom Nursery. These educational options make the community well-suited for families with young children.

Clinics and Hospitals Near Elysian Mansions

Healthcare services near Elysian Mansions include Apex Medical and Dental Clinics and Mediclinic Me’aisem, both located within a 10 to 15-minute drive. For more comprehensive care, NMC Royal Hospital in Dubai Investment Park is approximately 16 minutes away.

Location & Nearby Areas

Elysian Mansions Dubai enjoys a prime location with excellent connectivity to major destinations in Dubai. The Dubai International Stadium and The Els Club are both just a 7-minute drive away, making it convenient for sports and leisure activities. Dubai Production City and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311) can be reached in approximately 11 minutes, ensuring smooth daily commutes. Jumeirah Golf Estates, a premier golfing destination, is accessible in just 16 minutes by car.

The surrounding communities of DAMAC Hills, Dubai Sports City, and Dubai Studio City add to the area's appeal by offering additional lifestyle and entertainment options close to Elysian Mansions.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Elysian Mansions, Tilal Al Ghaf

data.answer:
From kayaking and paddleboarding in the Central Lagoon Al Ghaf to fitness boot camps and movie nights at Hive Park, residents will have no shortage of recreational activities. Families can enjoy outdoor BBQs, beach volleyball, or a stroll along the 18km of walking and cycling trails.

Beaches Near Elysian Mansions

The Central Lagoon Al Ghaf features a 400m open beach and 70,000 sq. m. of swimmable water. It is the centerpiece of the Tilal Al Ghaf lifestyle and offers residents private beach access for swimming, sunbathing, and beachside sports.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness and Beauty

Fitness enthusiasts can access the outdoor gyms, tennis and basketball courts, and indoor gym facilities planned within Tilal Al Ghaf. Nearby options like Gymnation Motor City and Arjan Fitness Gym are within a short driving distance. For salon services, residents can visit L’Atelier Hair and Beauty Salon or The Den Salon within 15 minutes.

Community Events

Hive Park within the master community is set to host year-round events including music festivals, open-air movie nights, and wellness programs. With the announcement of Plagette 32, Tilal Al Ghaf will feature high-end facilities such as a clubhouse, spa, restaurants, and a beach club operated by Sunset Hospitality.

Attractions and Landmarks

Nearby landmarks include The Els Club and Dubai Sports City, known for sporting events and entertainment. Jumeirah Golf Estates adds to the appeal for golf enthusiasts. The community’s master plan ensures close access to leisure, sports, and cultural venues.

Elysian Mansions off-plan villas promise a luxury lifestyle but are still under development. While the master community offers a broad range of planned amenities, some services like shopping malls, gyms, and restaurants may initially require trips to nearby areas. However, once fully developed, the Tilal Al Ghaf community amenities will provide a comprehensive living experience.

Where is Elysian Mansions located?

Elysian Mansions is located in Tilal Al Ghaf, a waterfront residential community near Harmony Villas.

Who is the developer of Elysian Mansions?

Majid Al Futtaim is the developer of Elysian Mansions.

What type of properties are available?

Luxurious 5 to 7-bedroom waterfront mansions in Dubai with smart-home features.

When is the handover date?

Handover is expected in Q4 2025.
Take a look at the location of Elysian Mansions in Tilal Al Ghaf with easy access to Central Lagoon Al Ghaf, nearby communities, and major transport routes.

data.content:
Elysian Mansions Dubai is an ultra-luxurious waterfront development within the upscale Tilal Al Ghaf community, developed by the renowned Majid Al Futtaim. Inspired by the mythical Elysian Fields, this residential project offers a serene escape amidst nature while remaining well-connected to the city’s key districts. With its distinctive architectural styles and resort-style amenities, Elysian Mansions is designed for those seeking exclusivity and elegance.

Situated near the Central Lagoon Al Ghaf, it boasts panoramic lagoon views, lush green landscapes, and premium lifestyle offerings. Residents will enjoy access to a wide range of Tilal Al Ghaf community amenities, including sandy beaches, sports courts, community parks, and educational institutions, making it one of the most sought-after addresses for families and luxury property seekers in Dubai.

Currently available as off-plan, Elysian Mansions villas range from five to seven bedrooms with bespoke design options. Smart home technology, spacious courtyards, and rooftop Sky Suites elevate these waterfront mansions in Dubai, offering future residents a highly customizable and contemporary living experience.
